items.title: Brock Bowers: Back at practice Thursday
items.description:
Bowers (ankle) was on the field for the start of Thursday's practice, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Baker Mayfield: Calls himself 'limited' Thursday
items.description:
Mayfield (foot/right thumb) said that he felt good but was "limited" at Thursday's practice, and he's hopeful to do more at Friday's session, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Caleb Douglas: Still in non-contact jersey
items.description:
Douglas (shoulder) continued to don a non-contact jersey during Thursday's practice, Barry Jackson of the Miami Herald reports.

items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt: Back at practice Thursday
items.description:
Commanders head coach Dan Quinn confirmed that Croskey-Merritt (groin) will practice Thursday, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.
